title: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark

entities.name: Farakatolar
entities.description: A Kav Memorial Navy harkener sergeant who leads a squad to investigate a drifting structure and dies trying to seize an artifact orb.

entities.name: Rakoro
entities.description: A Kav squad member wielding a beam axe, swallowed by a swarm in the structure.

entities.name: Takoluk
entities.description: A Kav squad member with a scanner and energy blades, whose skull is mysteriously smashed.

entities.name: Dornnuk
entities.description: A green-scaled Kav warrior who takes combat stimulants and tears himself apart while trying to shed.

entities.name: Haronar
entities.description: The Kav pilot who remains aboard the ship, whose radio fades into a mumbled prayer.

entities.name: Kav Memorial Navy
entities.description: The Kav navy that tracks, maps and retrieves fragments and artifacts of the collapsing homeworld.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: The people of Kavaron, whose squads mine and salvage their collapsing homeworld.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: A species that Dornnuk likens to wildcat thieves because they are terraforming a world the Kav hope to claim.

entities.name: The Vaar
entities.description: An old myth of beings who fled the Eldrazi into a virtual world, the Hylderhigh, and whose knowledge persists in physical nodes.

entities.name: Hylderhigh
entities.description: The virtual world of the Vaar, disconnected from reality except for a few spots.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The beings the Vaar ran from.

entities.name: White structure
entities.description: A twenty-kilometer white construction of smooth arcs that reseals itself and contains a vast spherical space, a node, and swarms; it is not a memorial vault.

entities.name: Node
entities.description: A swirling blue orb on a pedestal that is a physical node of the Vaar's knowledge, a billion times rarer than moxite, which moves and kills those who seek it.

entities.name: Kavaron That Is
entities.description: The ruined, crumbling half of the Kav homeworld that the KMN tracks.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: A ring of comets and ice at the edge of the Sothera system toward which the structure tumbled.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The star system containing Kavaron and the Wurmwall.

entities.name: Moxite
entities.description: A valuable resource compared to which the node is a billion times rarer.

entities.name: Creature of oily substance
entities.description: A featureless, oily humanoid blob inside the structure that touches Takoluk without harming him.

events.summary: Farakatolar's squad flies out to investigate a drifted fragment of Kavaron possibly a memorial vault, passing the glowing ruin of their world.
events.quote: Here, in this incandescent catastrophe, is the reason for all her missions.

events.summary: They find a twenty-kilometer white structure unlike any memorial vault, and the scope cannot image it.
events.quote: The ship slows and the white edge of a structure emerges from the darkness.

events.summary: Haronar lands on the structure and the squad drills through the wall, then cuts into the next chamber.
events.quote: The wall, though, doesn't crumble beneath Rakoro's blade. It peels back and curls up like skin.

events.summary: The squad finds the glowing blue orb on a pedestal, but the wall reseals itself behind them.
events.quote: but the hole itself is gone.

events.summary: The artifact vanishes from the room and the radio from Haronar degrades.
events.quote: But it's clearly gone, not even a mark where the pedestal was.

events.summary: The walls turn opalescent and the squad finds doorways and a corridor, then encounters an oily humanoid that touches Takoluk.
Takoluk's skull is found smashed in with no visible attacker, and a voice vibrates in their heads.
events.quote: But his skull has been smashed in.

events.summary: Dornnuk, driven by stimulants, tears off his armor and scales and runs off down the corridors.
events.quote: he screams and runs down the corridor, scraps of armor and skin flying.

events.summary: Farakatolar and Rakoro find a vast spherical chamber with the artifact on a platform at its center.
events.quote: on a small floating platform at the center of the massive space: the artifact.

events.summary: A swarm of millions of tiny things floods in, swallows Rakoro and condenses to a point before disappearing.
events.quote: Rakoro swings her axe uselessly, covered and drowning in the tiny things.

events.summary: Farakatolar reaches the artifact and loses contact with Haronar, who is praying.
events.quote: it's the desperate mumblings of a prayer.

events.summary: A voice declares escape incorrect and that from the many there must be one Vaar; Farakatolar realizes the orb is a node of the Vaar's knowledge.
events.quote: The Vaar. It is an old myth.

events.summary: Farakatolar reaches into the node, is pierced and grips the object inside as she is crushed to death.

relations.note: leads a KMN squad as sergeant

relations.quote: Harkener Sergeant Farakatolar and her small squad
Who'd we annoy to get sent off so far, Sarge?

relations.note: a node connected to the Vaar's ancient knowledge
relations.quote: Solid, physical spaces connected to the vastness of the Vaar's ancient knowledge.

relations.note: the Vaar ran from the Eldrazi
relations.quote: The Vaar who ran from the Eldrazi.
